goal: Review whether SPEC-M07-001 completely and safely translates the human-approved M07 PRD into an implementable local design without authorizing BUILD.

sources.location: Original 50-improvement task and explicit M07 PRD approval for documentary SPEC
sources.license_notes: User scope and gate decision; no external content.
Approved task requirements and local evidence.
CVG gate rules and existing neutral Harness target.

sources.location: Engineering Framework SPEC Engine and SPEC template
sources.version: installed skill revision read for this task

criteria.target: Every M07 goal, FR, NFR, AC, metric, and safety boundary maps to a design contract or explicitly blocked human decision.
criteria.evidence_method: Compare SPEC traceability and design sections with PRD 0028 and Discovery 0017.
criteria.conditions: No acceptance result may be claimed without its later candidate-bound evidence.

criteria.target: CURRENT observations are distinguished from PROPOSED target design, tied to repository sources, and bounded by the dirty-worktree and historical-inventory limitations.
criteria.evidence_method: Read cited source/manifests and compare terminology to Discovery; check that no static result is described as a build/runtime pass.

criteria.target: Components, ownership, policy input, internal edge model, report, boundaries, and failure behavior are sufficient to implement without introducing an unjustified runtime service or changing product behavior.
criteria.evidence_method: Inspect module table, inventory procedure, policy schema, CLI/report contract, and target direction.
criteria.conditions: Proposed public package and project-reference rules stay unapproved until human decision.

criteria.target: Production, test, build-only, type-only, dynamic, generated, alias, relative, and unresolved edges have distinct handling; manifest category rules are explicit and fail closed.
criteria.evidence_method: Adversarially inspect scanner algorithm and dependency-category rules for omissions, false passes, or unsupported assumptions.
criteria.conditions: External npm dependency coverage remains separate and existing AUD19-011 work is preserved.

criteria.target: Public workspace support status, export resolution, project-reference requiredness, exceptions, and candidate freshness are explicit, measurable, and never inferred from aliases or static counts.
criteria.evidence_method: Inspect policy fields, consumer verification, reference profiles, exception requirements, fingerprints, and decision table.
criteria.conditions: Unknown decisions block only their acceptance dimensions; no mass export/reference changes.

criteria.target: Coverage, parse, path, cycle, policy, stale-candidate, and output failures produce contained explicit outcomes; the scanner is local, read-only, and excludes real data and production actions.
criteria.evidence_method: Review failure table, report/path rules, security boundary, and inherited safety limits.
criteria.conditions: No code or operational check is run at SPEC preparation.

criteria.target: Future tests, isolated builds, consumer checks, result labels, candidate fingerprints, and evidence fields are executable and map to PRD acceptance without implying they were run.
criteria.evidence_method: Compare verification plan and report schema to AC1–AC9; confirm NOT_RUN and gate status are explicit.
criteria.conditions: No test or verification execution is authorized by the PRD decision.

criteria.target: The SPEC defines a coherent first vertical slice, bounded dependency order, compatibility treatment, rollback, and separate BUILD gates while preserving existing work.
criteria.evidence_method: Review slice table, build gate, candidate freeze, existing AUD19-011 handling, and rollback boundaries.
criteria.conditions: No implementation starts before human SPEC review and the local BUILD gate.

criteria.target: Open decisions and recommendations are visibly unapproved, assigned to the proper authority, and paired with the concrete effect of not approving them.
criteria.evidence_method: Inspect the human-decision table and gate/handoff text.
criteria.conditions: No product or architecture choice is inferred from package names or previous tasks.

criteria.target: A fresh-context critic reviews the frozen bar and exact SPEC artifact, reports each criterion and material gaps, and makes no changes.
criteria.evidence_method: Review critic report, artifact hash, and final adjudication.
criteria.conditions: If the agent service cannot provide an independent critic, report that limitation and do not claim I1.
